rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

prompt:

Preserve her light blonde hair, blue eyes, completely opaque white formal 1930s party dress, cemetery iron fence and general original painterly cinematic style. She is a solemn ghost, not malicious. [resurrection-mary-c05,c06,c09]
Change the calm portrait moment to an urgent turning movement as she RECEDES into the cemetery: head twists sharply back at us, blonde strands and skirt moving, one raised hand reaches toward viewer as it disappears. Make three large impossible ABSENT AREAS in her silhouette: the entire middle torso from ribs to waist is gone with cemetery stones seen sharply through it; the middle of her raised forearm is gone with intact opaque cuff/hand separated from upper arm; three fingertips disappear in broad interrupted segments. These are clean spectral absences, NOT wounds, torn clothes, smoke or glowing energy. Remaining face, shoulder and cloth remain solid opaque and fully modest. Face and separate intact shoulder/hand fragments fill the frame rather than becoming a small landscape. Uncanny absence must dominate visually; not a fashion photo or ordinary pretty woman standing.
Retain dark hand-shaped scorched marks on fence only as the explicitly disputed folklore account [resurrection-mary-c11]. Strong low-key single car-headlight lighting, black cemetery depth, high contrast, no luminous outlines, no ghost mist standing in for disappearance. Exactly one head, two arms, two natural eyes; no added anatomy. No text, logos, watermark, border, film/game references, nudity, explicit gore, fangs, evil expression, neon or magical ribbons.
